title: Fourier coefficients of supersets at maximal degree
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $p:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and let $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. If the cardinality of $S$ equals the Fourier degree of $p$ (the largest cardinality of a set with nonzero Fourier coefficient), then the sum of the Fourier coefficients indexed by all sets $U$ containing $S$ equals the Fourier coefficient indexed by $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the coordinate indices
